liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Music Never Stopped** (2 reviews): First set features huge versions of Music Never Stopped, Ramble On Rose, and Cassidy; Reviewer calls this the definitive version of the 1970s, closing the first set [11][16]
- **Werewolves of London** (2 reviews): The encore performance is criticized as an out-of-tune mess; Reviewer identifies this as the worst version of Werewolves of London they have heard [8][15]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Bobby lays down a tasty rhythm while Jerry plays with intense energy [8]
- **Stayin' Alive Tease** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the presence of a Stayin' Alive tease within the first set [7]
- **Me & My Uncle** (1 review): Bobby delivers almost understated great vocals on this first set tune [12]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): Bobby plays dual lead with Jerry, a rare moment of total synchronization [9]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): A nice bluesy jam exits Black Peter, turning quickly into Around and Around [15]

## The recordings

- **gd78-04-24.sbd.mattman.20605.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 4.68/5 by 31 [1]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.mccaw.3296.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4.77/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording is praised for its clarity and fullness, setting it apart from others [18]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.32899.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: The source recording does not have any noise reduction applied to it [4]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.97543.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 172 min; rated 4.67/5 by 21 [3]

## Around the show

- Bob and Donna goof off before the time change, described as really fun [7]
- Bobby plays aggressively with two lead guitars, prompting Jerry to compete intensely [17]
- A Stayin' Alive tease occurs within the Big River performance [3]
- Reviewer claims this performance is better than any famous 1977 Scarlet-Fire versions [10]
- Reviewer considers the transition to Fire on the Mountain comparable to May 8, 1977 [12]
- Reviewer suggests this Fire might be superior to the February 5, 1978 performance [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-04-24.sbd.mattman.20605.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.mccaw.3296.shnf**: transferred by Mike McCaw; source: MR>?>R>D>Digi96>Soundforge>CDWAV>SHN [2]. Also: Transferred directly from a 1979 DBX encoded reel to DAT, then Digi96 card to hard disk [2]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.32899.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [4]
- **gd1978-04-24.sbd.miller.97543.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 7: Horton Field House, Illinois State, Normal, IL 4/24/78 2013 US 3-CD set](https://eu.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-7-horton-field-house-illinois-state-normal-il-4-24-78-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2532997-790401?view=product-cro-06) [20]
- Poster by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 7: Horton Field House, Illinois State, Normal, IL 4/24/78 2013 US 3-CD set](https://uk.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-7-horton-field-house-illinois-state-normal-il-4-24-78-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2532997-790401) [21]
- Poster by KINGKONG: [Grateful Dead – Dave's Picks, Volume 7 (Horton Field House, Illinois State, Normal, IL • 4/24/78) ■YMR■ | KINGKONG power](https://kkrecords.buyshop.jp/items/74742200) [22]
- Poster by Ella Jahraus All: [The music never stopped: 50-plus years of campus concerts](https://news.illinoisstate.edu/2023/11/the-music-never-stopped/) [23]
